representation_fit.evidence: App is a 2D spatial floor canvas matching the brief's spatial-workspace/canvas_object shape: zones as rects and tiles as placed objects (screenshots 1280x860 & 1440x900 show 4 colored zones, 13 tiles); membership derives from position alone (app.js:78-85 zoneAt/zoneOf; inspector note app.js:556 'Facts above derive from position alone'); tagline states the success criterion '落位即意图 · placement is intent' (index.html:16).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the create-and-place canvas; first two toolbar buttons are '＋ Object N' and '＋ Zone R' (index.html:19-20, visible in both screenshots); status bar leads with 'Ready — Tab selects · N new object · R new zone' (app.js:597); rail hint 'Select a tile, then press 1–8 to send it to that zone' (index.html:38).

time_to_understand.evidence: Brand + tagline, toolbar, zone rail with counts and number keys, inspector how-to, and status hints all read at a glance in both screenshots; initial scene is inlined so first paint is usable (app.js:15-41, boot→fitView app.js:907-909). Docked one point: fit-view renders tiles at 50% (1280x860) / 61% (1440x900) so 12px tile names (styles.css:217-221) project well below readable size, corroborated by receipt check type.min_projected_size=fail.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single-screen app (index.html:33-54 layout = rail + viewport + inspector); primary objects visible with zero navigation; keyboard map is one press '?' (index.html:28, app.js:771); every view op (fit 0, focus F, zoom +/−) reachable without leaving the canvas (app.js:828-840).

context_loss.evidence: No navigation or mode loss: rename is an in-place overlay (app.js:399-424); help is a modal that returns focus to the viewport on close (app.js:864-869); toolbar buttons hand focus back to the canvas so shortcuts keep flowing (app.js:941-955); autosave is debounced and never surfaces a loading state (app.js:132-147).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Exactly five permanent surfaces, each load-bearing: titlebar toolbar, zone rail, canvas, inspector, status bar (index.html:12-60); the large keyboard-map surface (index.html:62-127) is hidden until '?' — nothing decorative or redundant observed in either screenshot.

accessibility.evidence: Strong keyboard/ARIA affordances: focus-visible outlines (styles.css:67-70), role=toolbar with aria-labels (index.html:18), aria-pressed on Snap (index.html:22, app.js:608), aria-live status (index.html:57), tiles expose role=button + aria-label (app.js:469-471), dialog aria-modal (index.html:62). Receipt: a11y.contrast=pass, but a11y.target_size=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail; source shows concretely small targets — 12px zone dots (styles.css:222-227), 10-11px kbd chips (styles.css:41-51, 194), compact zone chips (styles.css:184). a11y.focus_order=skipped, unverifiable.

frontend_rework.evidence: Both screenshots show clean layouts — no collisions (layout.responsive_collision=pass) and no clipped text (text.truncation=pass) at 1280x860 or 1440x900; however the receipt records 3 fails (layout.overflow, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) out of 7 checks, and the target/type-size fails are corroborated by small surfaces in styles.css (12px dots, 10-11px kbd, 12px names at sub-100% zoom), implying at least one defect-fix pass despite no visible defect.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 'spatial operations have keyboard equivalents' is addressed exhaustively: dedicated keyboard-map overlay enumerating create/move/view/edit equivalents (index.html:62-127); implemented in app.js — N/R ghost placement with arrow positioning and Enter drop (app.js:774-785), arrow nudge incl. regions (app.js:316-336), 1–8 send-to-zone (app.js:374-388, 853-857), [ ] z-order (app.js:841-842), WASD pan (app.js:847-851), Ctrl+D duplicate / Del delete / G snap (app.js:799-803, 817-827); kbd hints surface in rail, chips, inspector (app.js:458, 516, 577-581); pointer ops each have a stated keyboard counterpart (help foot, index.html:125).

defects_observed: Receipt a11y.target_size=fail, consistent with 12px zone dots (styles.css:222-227), 10-11px kbd chips (styles.css:41-51, styles.css:194), and small zone chips (styles.css:177-194)
Receipt type.min_projected_size=fail: 10px link labels (styles.css:242) and 12px tile names (styles.css:217-221) render at 6-7px effective at the 50-61% initial fit zoom seen in both screenshots
Receipt layout.overflow=fail with no overflow visible in either screenshot — defect not visually locatable
Receipt a11y.focus_order=skipped, so focus-order quality is unverified
missing_evidence: a11y.focus_order — check skipped in measurement-summary.json, no source or screenshot evidence can substitute
layout.overflow — failing check with no observable overflow location in either viewport
scores.overall_note: impl-05 ('Plotboard') is a tight match for the brief's create × spatial-workspace cell: a single dark floor canvas where 13 tiles sit inside 4 zones, zone membership and neighbor facts derive purely from position (app.js:78-85, inspector copy app.js:556), and the 'placement is intent' criterion is stated in the header (index.html:16). The primary create/place task dominates the first screen and is usable at first paint via an inlined scene (app.js:15-41). The acceptance seed — keyboard equivalents for every spatial operation — is not merely present but systematic, with a dedicated keyboard map (index.html:62-127) and full handler coverage (app.js:757-858), including keyboard parity for zone moves and send-to-zone 1–8. Deductions come from objective receipt failures rather than visible flaws: both screenshots are clean (responsive_collision and truncation pass), yet target_size and min_projected_size fail, traceable in styles.css to 10-12px dots, chips, and labels that project even smaller at the 50-61% initial zoom; layout.overflow fails without a visible location, and focus_order was skipped so keyboard traversal order is unverified. Error-rate data is referenced as supplied and not rescored; model-judged scores here are not human preference.
